name: @red-cup-engineering/gitmodules-file-codec-service
description: Parses a .gitmodules file into submodule entries and encodes entries back to .gitmodules text, and reads the two on-disk shapes that report submodule pin state (submodule status lines and raw gitlink lines). Use when code needs to read or rewrite .gitmodules, or interpret submodule status/gitlink output, without shelling out to git for the parsing itself.

scripts.check: node --check src/gitmodules.mjs && node --check scripts/read-gitmodules.mjs && node --check test/gitmodules.test.mjs && node --check test/read-gitmodules.test.mjs
